description: This file defines the internal class RateLimiter within the Aws\Retry namespace. It implements a rate limiting mechanism for AWS SDK operations, managing token buckets, measuring transaction rates, and applying cubic throttle logic to control request sending rates.

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: Implements rate limiting logic using token buckets and cubic throttle algorithms for AWS SDK request management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RateLimiter with optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the rate limiter is currently enabled.

methods.name: getSendToken
methods.description: Attempt to acquire a token for sending a request.

methods.name: updateSendingRate
methods.description: Updates the rate and throttling state based on whether a request was throttled.

methods.name: acquireToken
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the specified amount of tokens, sleeping if necessary.

methods.name: calculateTimeWindow
methods.description: Calculates the dynamic time window for the cubic algorithm.

methods.name: cubicSuccess
methods.description: Calculates the new rate after a successful request based on the cubic algorithm.

methods.name: cubicThrottle
methods.description: Calculates the throttled rate based on the cubic algorithm.

methods.name: refillTokenBucket
methods.description: Refills the token bucket based on elapsed time and fill rate.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp, using a provided callable or microtime.

methods.name: updateMeasuredRate
methods.description: Updates the measured transaction rate based on recent activity.

methods.name: updateTokenBucketRate
methods.description: Updates the token bucket parameters (fill rate and max capacity).
